A accepts the three saved paid paraphrases but still accepts I paid it today, but I did not actually pay this overdue amount. findings.title: Consent question scope, pause lifetime and outstanding product notes
findings.observed: Inconsistent confirm rows for callback, reported yes, historical confirmation or yes to continuation prepare a synthetic promise request. Two synthetic failures of the first note end the call before sibling notes are attempted. Three successful note receipts preserve expected closure.

Prescribed DMY, bank swap-hint clarification, self/quote/incomplete controls and tested payment weekday conflict guards pass.
